facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports that the Ministry of Health announced on 23 September 2025 the launch of deployment of electronic medical information systems across 130 health facilities, with hospitals to replace paper records gradually with integrated platforms holding payments, consultations and test results; no denominator is given.

Ecofin Agency reports that the 130-facility rollout announced on 23 September 2025 is part of the government's 10-year national digital health strategy, and that the government plans to extend the programme nationwide in the medium term.

Ecofin Agency reports the 130-facility deployment as launched by Ethiopia and announced by the Ministry of Health on 23 September 2025, under the government's strategy; no partner, vendor or funding source is named.

systems.tiers: 130 health facilities; hospitals named, level not stated
